eventMetadata.context_description:
**Current short-range forecasts from the Korea Meteorological Administration and ensemble models indicate a daytime high near 27–28°C for Busan on June 11, driven by typical early-June conditions of moderate southwesterly flow, partial cloud cover, and coastal moderation from the East Sea.** 

Seasonal climatology places average June maxima around 26°C, with recent days showing gradual warming under building high pressure that limits strong onshore cooling. Minor differences in predicted insolation and boundary-layer mixing explain the tight clustering between 27°C and 29°C outcomes, while probabilities drop sharply above 30°C due to the absence of strong subtropical ridging or clear-sky amplification in the latest model runs. Updated guidance expected from KMA this evening will likely refine these thresholds ahead of market resolution.
